label: question

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

You can see the running version by calling `GET /api/v1/health` (see docs/API.md), which returns a `version` field sourced from package.json; it's also printed at the top of README.md for the shipped release. Note: triage of this issue only covers the question asked here — closing the other referenced issues (#4203, #4206, #4304, #4313, #4406) isn't something this process does on your behalf; please close those individually if they're resolved on your end.
